Definition: from G4862 and G4198; to journey together; by implication, to assemble:--go with, resort.
BiblicalUsage: Great multitudes go with Jesus, and He turns to tell them what following will cost, and on the road to Emmaus Jesus Himself draws near and goes with two disciples who do not yet know Him. Going with Jesus is the whole of discipleship, whether in a crowd or on a lonely road.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the road is worth walking because Jesus walks it with me, and I hold that He draws near to those who are still trying to understand.
